rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - Intrinsic: n = p = n_i - Mass-action law: n·p = n_i² - Donor level just below CB; acceptor level just above VB

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Doped crystals stay neutral** — impurity atoms are neutral; only the carrier balance changes.  ·  **n-type: pentavalent donor, electrons majority. p-type: trivalent acceptor, holes majority.**

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: "Doping is the deliberate addition of impurities to increase a semiconductor's conductivity."

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: ***Si + P*** — n-type; ***Si + B*** — p-type: one atom per million transforms conductivity.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Verified PYQs: intrinsic + carriers (2022, 2024 — 2m); doping, n vs p (2024, 3m).

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — Engineering Conductivity Atom by Atom Pure silicon conducts feebly. Add one phosphorus atom per million silicon atoms and conductivity jumps a thousandfold. **Doping** — the deliberate addition of impurities — turns a passive crystal into the raw material of every diode, transistor and solar cell.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts (NEB 2022, 2024) ### 2.1 Intrinsic semiconductors (NEB 2022, 2024, 2m) An **intrinsic semiconductor** is a pure crystal (e.g. pure Si or Ge) with no added impurities. Thermal energy breaks covalent bonds, promoting electrons to the conduction band: - **Electron:** a negatively charged charge carrier promoted to the conduction band.…

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB 2024 (3m): Define doping; distinguish n-type and p-type.** — Doping adds trace impurities to boost conductivity. n-type: pentavalent (P, As) donates extra electrons; electrons majority. p-type: trivalent (B, Al) creates extra holes; holes majority. Both crystals remain neutral.

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: State neutrality and majority/minority carriers explicitly.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **A hole is a mobile positive vacancy** — it drifts with the field as electrons hop into it.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: Intrinsic: pure, n = p = n_i. n-type: P/As donors. p-type: B/Al acceptors.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Doping ratios of 10⁻⁶ raise conductivity a thousandfold — the leverage of band engineering.
